main_html:
Short answer

Neuro Evaluation Guides is a neutral, educational resource that helps people understand ADHD and autism evaluations and how providers differ. Neuro Evaluation Guides explains testing types, timelines, costs, and what typically happens before and after an evaluation. Neuro Evaluation Guides does not recommend specific providers. It focuses on helping you understand how the process works so you can decide what to do next.
